en: Black‑and‑white view of a tree‑lined residential street in a late‑19th/early‑20th‑century European suburb. The image shows several ornate bourgeois villas with hipped roofs and stucco facades, some with small towers or elaborate balconies. Front gardens are fenced, and a wide unpaved street with young trees runs through the center. Forested hills are visible in the distant background. One prominent building in the left foreground has decorative wall paintings and a name written high on its facade.
